context: A mom comforts her young son after a tearful day
purpose: Teach: 幼児/こころ/叫び/貧しい/筈/云々/前者/師匠

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔ちゃん、こころが落ち着くまでママがそばにいるからね。
lines.en: Sho-chan, Mommy will stay by your side until your heart calms down.
lines.style: Warm maternal tone, soft and reassuring whisper close to the child

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: だって、僕の叫び声、みんな笑ったんだもん…
lines.en: But everyone laughed when I cried out loud...
lines.style: Tearful sniffling child voice, broken phrasing with held-back sobs

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ママもね、幼児だった頃、同じように泣いてた筈なの。
lines.en: You know, when Mommy was a little kid, she must have cried just the same way.
lines.style: Gentle confessional tone, slow soothing pace with a soft sigh

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ほんと?ママも悲しくて、心が貧しいみたいな気持ちになったの?
lines.en: Really? Did Mommy feel sad too, like her heart was empty inside?
lines.style: Curious wobbly child voice, hesitant phrasing with little hiccups

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、なったよ。誰が悪いとか云々より、翔の気持ちが一番大事なの。
lines.en: Yes, she did. More than fussing about who's wrong or whatever, your feelings matter most.
lines.style: Firm but tender, deliberate pacing on the emotional key words

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえ、泣いてる前者の僕と、強い僕、どっちが本物なのかな…
lines.en: Hey, the crying first me and the strong me—which one is the real me?
lines.style: Quiet searching child voice, slow hesitant questioning between sniffs

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 両方ぜんぶ翔だよ。ママは立派な師匠じゃないけど、ずっと翔の味方だからね。
lines.en: Both of them are you. Mommy isn't some grand master, but she's always on your side.
lines.style: Soft warm laughter, ending with a gentle kiss on the forehead
